algorithm_steps.step_description: Build the base HTML structure that will host the notes application, including a header, a note entry form, a container for the notes list, and a footer.
instructions: Add a <!DOCTYPE html> declaration and open <html> with lang="en".
Inside <head>, include <meta charset="UTF-8">, <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">, and a <title>Notes App</title>.

Create a <body> containing: a <header> with an <h1> title, a <section id="note-form"> with a <textarea id="note-input" placeholder="Write a note..." required> and a <button id="add-btn">Add</button>, a <main id="notes-container"></main> for rendering notes, and a <footer> with a small copyright line.

algorithm_steps.step_description: Style the page with a dark color palette, smooth transitions, and responsive layout using only inline CSS.
instructions: Insert a <style> block directly after the <title> tag.
Apply a flex column layout to body, set background to var(--bg), and use font-family: system-ui, sans-serif.
Style header, footer, #note-form, textarea, button, and .note-card with rounded corners, box‑shadows, and hover effects using the defined variables.
Make #notes-container a CSS grid that adapts to screen width (minmax(250px, 1fr)).

algorithm_steps.step_description: Create all functions needed to add, edit, delete, persist, and render notes using localStorage.
instructions: Add a <script> block at the end of <body>.
Write function saveNotes() that stringifies notes and stores them under the key 'notes'.

Write function renderNotes() that clears #notes-container and iterates over notes, creating a div.note-card for each with the note text, an edit button, and a delete button; attach data-index attributes.
Write function addNote(text) that pushes {text, id:Date.now()} into notes, calls saveNotes() and renderNotes().
Write function editNote(index, newText) that updates notes[index].text, then calls saveNotes() and renderNotes().
Write function deleteNote(index) that splices notes at index, then calls saveNotes() and renderNotes().

algorithm_steps.step_description: Connect the form and note cards to the JavaScript functions, and render existing notes on page load.
instructions: Add an event listener to #add-btn that reads #note-input.value, trims it, calls addNote(value) if not empty, and then clears the textarea.

Delegate click events on #notes-container: if the target matches .edit-btn, prompt the user for new text, then call editNote(index, newText); if the target matches .delete-btn, confirm deletion and call deleteNote(index).
After defining all functions, call renderNotes() once so stored notes appear immediately.
Prevent form submission default behavior by using e.preventDefault() on the button click handler.
